read_log_file: read a JSON-lines log file and extract key-value pairs with optional smoothing
parse_log_files: parse multiple seed log files and compute interpolated means and half standard deviations
print_result: plot aggregated training or evaluation results from multiple seeds with shaded error bands
plot_seeds: plot individual seed trajectories from log files on a single matplotlib figure
plot_experiment: plot and compare multiple experiments with optional baseline overlays for a given task
